description: Precedence (ADR 0026 §2; the 0002 lead's order: limits and shape, then base64url of protected headers and signatures, then protected-header JSON, then the payload's base64url under the effective b64, then header structure, then steps 5–9): an HS256 JWS verified with a 31-octet key (step 8) whose MAC is also wrong (first character changed, step 9) fails with the step 8 code
